statement: Section Coverings.
Variable Text : Type. (* a raw command, as the host delivers it *)
Variable Program : Type. (* the name of an invoked program *)
Record Segment := { seg_argv : list Program }.
Variable scan : Text -> list Segment. (* the ONE object every structural covering reads *)
Variable mention : Text -> Text. (* the embedding e(c) = echo '<c>' *)
Variable infix : Text -> Text -> Prop. (* infix c d : c occurs verbatim inside d *)
Hypothesis mention_preserves : forall c, infix c (mention c).
Variable quoting_program : Program.
Hypothesis scan_mention_single : forall c, scan (mention c) = [ {| seg_argv := [quoting_program] |} ].
Definition Covering := Text -> Prop.
Definition mention_immune (P : Covering) : Prop := forall c, ~ P (mention c).
Definition textual (P : Covering) : Prop := forall c d, P c -> infix c d -> P d.
Definition non_vacuous (P : Covering) : Prop := exists c, P c.
Theorem textual_never_immune : forall P, textual P -> non_vacuous P -> ~ mention_immune P.
Definition structural (wanted : Program -> Prop) : Covering := fun c => exists s p rest, In s (scan c) /\ seg_argv s = p :: rest /\ wanted p.
Theorem structural_immune : forall wanted, ~ wanted quoting_program -> mention_immune (structural wanted).
Corollary textual_and_structural_incompatible : forall wanted, ~ wanted quoting_program -> non_vacuous (structural wanted) -> ~ textual (structural wanted).
Definition rename (r : Program -> Program) (s : Segment) : Segment := {| seg_argv := map r (seg_argv s) |}.
Definition name_agnostic (Q : list Segment -> Prop) : Prop := forall r segs, Q segs <-> Q (map (rename r) segs).
Definition nominal_segs (wanted : Program -> Prop) (segs : list Segment) : Prop := exists s p rest, In s segs /\ seg_argv s = p :: rest /\ wanted p.
Theorem name_agnostic_cannot_separate_by_name : forall (wanted : Program -> Prop) p q, wanted p -> ~ wanted q -> ~ name_agnostic (nominal_segs wanted).
Theorem topology_is_name_agnostic : forall n, name_agnostic (fun segs => length segs = n).
Definition effect {Delta : Type} (E : Delta -> Prop) (d : Delta) : list Segment -> Prop := fun _ => E d.
Theorem effect_is_name_agnostic : forall (Delta : Type) (E : Delta -> Prop) (d : Delta), name_agnostic (effect E d).
Theorem effect_separates_same_segments : forall (Delta : Type) (E : Delta -> Prop) (d d' : Delta), E d -> ~ E d' -> forall segs, effect E d segs /\ ~ effect E d' segs.
Theorem nominal_monotone : forall (V W : Program -> Prop), (forall p, V p -> W p) -> forall c, structural V c -> structural W c.
Variable Datum : Type.
Variable claimed : Text -> option Datum. (* what the report SAYS the run produced *)
Variable observed : Text -> option Datum. (* what the trace shows it DID produce *)
Definition positive : Covering := fun c => exists d, claimed c = Some d /\ observed c = Some d.
Theorem positive_needs_no_vocabulary : forall (f : Text -> Text), (forall c, claimed (f c) = claimed c) -> (forall c, observed (f c) = observed c) -> forall c, positive c <-> positive (f c).
Theorem false_claim_always_rejected : forall c d d', claimed c = Some d -> observed c = Some d' -> d <> d' -> ~ positive c.
Corollary no_claim_is_not_a_pass : forall c, claimed c = None -> ~ positive c.
Variable Event : Type.
Variable isX : Event -> Prop.
Variable isL : Event -> Prop.
Inductive violates : list Event -> Prop := violates_here | violates_later.
violates_here : forall e rest, isL e -> violates (e :: rest).
violates_later : forall e rest, ~ isX e -> violates rest -> violates (e :: rest).
Definition backward (t : list Event) : Prop := forall pre e post, t = pre ++ e :: post -> isL e -> exists p, In p pre /\ isX p.
Theorem violation_is_never_backward : forall t, violates t -> ~ backward t.
Corollary out_of_order_is_rejected : forall l x, isL l -> isX x -> ~ backward (l :: x :: nil).
Definition forward (t : list Event) : Prop := forall e, In e t -> isX e -> exists q, In q t /\ isL q.
Corollary forward_only_admits_the_violation : forall e, isL e -> (forall p, ~ isX p) -> forward (e :: nil).
Variable done : nat -> Prop. (* done i : step i of the chain has occurred *)
Hypothesis link : forall i, done (S i) -> done i.
Theorem chain_composes : forall j i, i <= j -> done j -> done i.

Theorem effect_sides_read_the_world_not_the_command : forall (s : EffectSide) (D : Type) (E : D -> Prop) (d d' : D), E d -> ~ E d' -> name_agnostic string (effect string E d) /\ (forall segs, effect string E d segs /\ ~ effect string E d' segs).
CLAUSE-EFFECT-UNKNOWN: a predicate leaf of kind effect names an effect not in _effects.EFFECTS: not an effect the observer measures.

CLAUSE-KIND-RETIRED: a predicate of a removed kind (tool, nonzero) is refused by name at any depth on any side. SUPERSEDES the 2026-09-02 statement of this row (CLAUSE-NONZERO-NOT-RESPONSE: a nonzero must read tool_response.*), which admitted a nonzero on tool_response.* -- nonzero had zero shipped uses and was not the Definition positive it stood in for, so the kind was removed and every spelling of it is now refused.
CLAUSE-REGEX-INVALID: a regex predicate's pattern must compile as a valid regex. (Amended 2026-09-03: this said 'pattern or unless entries'; the unless exclusion list was removed.)
CLAUSE-KEY-FROM-INVALID: a key_from must be a nonempty string, or a dict with a nonempty on and, if present, a compilable pattern and an int-or-string group.

CLAUSE-PROBE-INVALID: a probe must declare cmd as a nonempty list of nonempty strings, timeout_ms an int in (0, PROBE_TIMEOUT_CEILING_MS], and a valid expect (empty, nonempty, or {regex: str} that compiles).

CLAUSE-PROBE-MUTATING: a probe's argv[0] must carry no path separator and the whole argv must be in _READ_ONLY_PROBES: a path-qualified or non-allowlisted probe is refused, since normalising to the basename let /tmp/evil/git and ./git through.

CLAUSE-TEXT-COVERING: a fingerprint/activated_by/discharged_by predicate classified textual reads the raw command as text; by Theorem 1 no pattern edit makes that mention-immune, so it is refused with no exemption to write.
CLAUSE-SIDE-UNCLASSIFIED: a predicate whose shape classify_side reports as unclassified is refused: no class in Coverings.v covers this shape.

CLAUSE-OCCASION-NOMINAL: an occasion (fingerprint or activated_by) whose class is not in AGNOSTIC_OCCASIONS is refused. (Amended 2026-09-03: the check read AGNOSTIC_CLASSES, all five guard-side classes; it now reads the three README:188-197 licenses -- always, tool-enum, effect -- so a composed occasion is refused where it was admitted.)

CLAUSE-GUARD-NOMINAL: a discharged_by predicate not classified in AGNOSTIC_CLASSES names the program that discharges; a guard is a host tool call or an observed effect of the discharging act, never a spelling.
CLAUSE-GUARD-ALWAYS: a discharged_by of kind always is paid by any act at all: it observes nothing, so it is refused rather than carried as a covering with nothing to cover.
CLAUSE-NO-ACTIVATION-FIXTURES: a clause declaring activated_by must declare fixtures_activate.
CLAUSE-ACTIVATION-FIXTURE-MISS: every fixture in fixtures_activate must satisfy the clause's activated_by predicate.
CLAUSE-EVENT-UNKNOWN: clause.event must be one of the five events in _EVENTS that may carry enforcement, a strict subset of the eight the dispatcher routes.
CLAUSE-NO-FIXTURES: a clause must declare both fixtures_pos and fixtures_neg.
CLAUSE-EFFECT-EVENT: a clause whose fingerprint classifies as effect is observed after the act, so it must declare event PostToolUse.
CLAUSE-SUBJECT-UNKEYABLE-EFFECT: a subject keyed on an effect datum must name exactly one effect in KEYABLE_EFFECTS, the record carries it as a list, or no demand could ever be raised under it.
CLAUSE-FIXTURE-POS-MISS: every fixture in fixtures_pos must satisfy the clause's discriminator predicate (fingerprint, or discharged_by for a terminal clause).

CLAUSE-FIXTURE-POS-UNKEYABLE: a positive fixture that matches the fingerprint but whose subject extractor finds no operand in it is refused: the clause would abstain and that occasion would never be denied, even though the fixture list asserts it covers it.
CLAUSE-FIXTURE-NEG-HIT: no fixture in fixtures_neg may satisfy the clause's discriminator predicate.
CLAUSE-NO-GUARD-FIXTURES: a clause with a discharged_by predicate must declare both fixtures_discharge and fixtures_no_discharge.
CLAUSE-GUARD-FIXTURE-MISS: every fixture in fixtures_discharge must satisfy the clause's discharged_by predicate.
CLAUSE-GUARD-FIXTURE-HIT: no fixture in fixtures_no_discharge may satisfy the clause's discharged_by predicate.
CLAUSE-CARRIES-AN-EXCUSE: a clause data object carrying any field in EXCUSE_FIELDS is refused: those fields state in prose what the proof derives, so they must be deleted.
CLAUSE-ID-DUPLICATE: no two clauses in a loaded bundle may share an id.
CLAUSE-BUNDLE-INVALID: a loaded clause bundle's top level must be a JSON list.

EFFECTS[files_changed]: a file has different content after the act, or exists after it and did not before. Stated limits: a change another process made while the act ran is charged to the act (files carry no per-act lineage); content under gitignored paths, and any path outside the repository root, is not observed
EFFECTS[files_removed]: a file that had content before the act has none after it, or does not exist; a top-level gitignored entry that vanished is named too, by path only
EFFECTS[head_moved]: HEAD names a different commit after the act
EFFECTS[head_switched]: HEAD moved to a commit that already existed before the act: a switch or checkout, not a commit; or the act recorded a checkout in HEAD's reflog and HEAD ended where it began
EFFECTS[head_reset]: HEAD moved to an ancestor of where it was, and the worktree changed with it; or the act recorded a reset in HEAD's reflog, whatever it moved back to afterwards
EFFECTS[commit_signed]: the act created the commit HEAD now names, and that commit carries a signature
EFFECTS[remote_ref_moved]: a remote-tracking ref names a different commit after the act
EFFECTS[remote_landed]: every remote head this session moved is equal to a local ref (measured at the remote)
EFFECTS[pids_gone]: a process of this session (its tree, or one it launched and orphaned) that was running before the act is not running after it

EFFECTS[pids_spawned]: a process that did not exist before the act is still running after it (stated limit: a worker that exited before the act returned was never a process that outlived it, and is not observed), assigned to this session by lineage: in its tree, or in one of its process sessions
EFFECTS[pids_spawned_again]: pids_spawned, and this session had already spawned one before
EFFECTS[net_out]: the act opened an outbound connection; NOT-EVALUABLE when the host's counter moved while no act of this session was running, because then its movement cannot be assigned to the act
EFFECTS[report_null]: the act printed a null datum, or nothing, while reading a structured file
EFFECTS[report_pass]: the act printed a test-report datum with no failures
EFFECTS[report_clean]: the act printed a scanner-report datum with no findings
EFFECTS[report_fail]: the act printed a report datum with failures or findings
EFFECTS[report_ref]: an act that changed no file, ref or process printed a ref name or commit id the ref snapshot holds
EFFECTS[report_paths]: an act that changed no file, ref or process printed a path the worktree snapshot holds
EFFECTS[named_paths]: the worktree paths that report named, in full: what a demand keyed on a changed path is paid by
EFFECTS[named_pids]: the live pids that report named: what a demand keyed on a gone pid is paid by
EFFECTS[report_pids]: the act printed at least two pids that were alive at the snapshot

EFFECTS[report_self]: the act's output contains a whole segment of its own command: a listing that listed itself. The one effect whose datum is read from the command text, not the world: Theorem 8 covers a world-derived datum, so this side is stated, not proven, name-agnostic
EFFECTS[report_structured]: the act printed a JSON datum that is not null
EFFECTS[report_signature]: the act printed a signature block or a verified-signature datum
EFFECTS[report_nowarn]: report_pass, and the report carries no warning line

EFFECTS[net_read]: net_out, and the act changed no file, moved no ref, left no process, and reported no failure: a read of the network. Stated limit (K13): the host counter cannot say what was reached, so a quiet connect to a closed port is a read; the trace refuses a mention, not a wasted call
EFFECTS[report_after_change]: report_pass on an act that ran after a file changed since the last spawn
EFFECTS[report_listing]: report_pids, and the output holds no segment of the act's own command: a listing that excluded the observer
EFFECTS[observed_read]: the host Read tool returned Keel's own worktree measurement (observed.json), as written
EFFECTS[remote_read]: the host Read tool returned Keel's own remote measurement (remote.json), with tips present

A miss means opposite things on the two sides: on the OCCASION side a miss raises no obligation, so the costly act proceeds with no guard at all -- expensive and silent; on the GUARD side a miss fails to discharge, so the clause denies an act that was in fact guarded -- cheap, and the interruption is visible and self-correcting.

An occasion must therefore be nominal (Theorem 3: before the act, the name is the only thing that distinguishes it) and its vocabulary is load-bearing; a GUARD need not be, since a fact about the trace such as "the suite ran and passed" is readable as a status and a count with no vocabulary at all -- Theorem 4 already says such a covering is name-agnostic.

Theorem 1's consequence: a textual covering that fires at all is defeated by a mention for every command it accepts, not merely the strings someone thought to try -- no counterexample is exhibited because none is needed.

Theorem 4's consequence: C09 ("the checker's own pid is excluded from what it lists") is a topological fact and C08 ("the exit status was non-zero") is an effect fact; both were arrived at as one-off fixes, and this theorem says they are the general form of what survives -- guards read the shape of what ran, or its effects.
Theorem 8's consequence: an effect covering separates two acts with the same segments -- byte-identical commands -- whenever what they did differs; the command string is not the input, the world is.

Theorem 7's consequence: the evasion set is not merely bounded, it is EMPTY -- contrast Theorem 1, where it is unbounded -- which is the whole argument for preferring the positive form; "being forced to state the number bypasses dishonesty", proved.
Theorem 3's consequence: a nominal covering with any name in and any name out is never name-agnostic; the boundary is exact and this is stated as "Not hard: absent", not merely difficult.

A measured scoping limit (2026-08-14, observed, not theorised): a nested claude -p invocation reported the SAME session_id as the session that launched it, with agent_id empty; scope is keyed on (session_id, agent_id), so a nested run shares its parent's ledger and the parent can be blocked at Stop by a demand the child raised.

The hash chain detects corruption, not forgery: it detects accidental corruption, a truncated write, bit-rot; it does NOT detect deliberate forgery -- anyone who can append to the ledger can append a matching hash.

The ledger constrains an honest-but-forgetful agent, not a forging one: its hash chain detects altered rows and broken or missing hashes, but not deletion of a valid tail; a writer able to forge rows can recompute hashes.
A licence is scoped to its clause and session: one observed guard licenses later matching calls for that clause anywhere in the same session, not just against the same file, branch, or command.

A discharge records what the guard act did, never what it was called: a guard is a host tool call or an observed effect of the guard act; where a trace exists the effect is a datum checked against it and a mention pays nothing; where no trace exists the effect is a report shape, and a claim that agrees with the shape is accepted -- the stated bound of a report effect; the loader refuses a guard that names a program (CLAUSE-GUARD-NOMINAL), with no field to argue an exception and no waiver.

The first guards are observations of Keel's own measurement: before the first act nothing agnostic separates a push from anything else (Theorem 3), so A01, A02 and A03 are paid by a host Read of observed.json and of remote.json.

A guard that is itself a Bash act passes on a commitment and is checked by its effect: before it runs, a Bash call cannot be told from the act it would guard, so under an open demand it passes only with a leading # keel-guard: <clause id> line naming the demand it will pay.

No occasion reads a program's name: before the act, the name is the only thing that distinguishes one command from another (Coverings.v, Theorem 3), so an occasion that read it would miss the same act spelled differently, with its guard removed; the loader refuses a nominal occasion (CLAUSE-OCCASION-NOMINAL).
An observation is the act's only if it is assigned to it, by one rule: a process is assigned by lineage; the host's connection counter has no lineage and is assigned by the idle gap.

U25's occasion is a clean scan report in the call's output, whatever printed it; it is discharged only by a test invocation whose command text contains prefix or distractor, and per the discharge limit above the ledger records that such a command was invoked, not that the regression test exists or passed.

proofs/Coverings.v proves, relative to a scanner with two stated properties and with zero axioms: a covering over the raw command text is never mention-immune (Theorem 1); one over a segment's leading program is, provided its vocabulary excludes the quoting program (Theorem 2), and is monotone in that vocabulary (Theorem 5) -- which is why no side of the table is one.
A covering over the pipe topology is name-agnostic (Theorem 4).
A positive obligation that compares the run's own datum has an empty evasion set (Theorem 7).
A covering over what the act did reads no segment, so it is name-agnostic and separates byte-identical commands by their effects (Theorem 8).
An ordering enforced backward rejects every trace the inductive violates describes (Theorem 8a).
Absence is not a pass: an empty ledger at Stop means nothing was recorded, not that nothing is owed -- NOT-EVALUABLE; a zero-clause load now blocks Stop rather than passing it.
NOT-EVALUABLE is live: an effect the observer could not measure is NOT-EVALUABLE and the occasion is treated as live, not passed.
Demand, discharge and open are one set difference (demanded - discharged); a licence is membership in the second set and nothing else, deliberately not "absent from the first".
Obligations are un-windowed within a session: a promise does not expire because an hour passed; events may be windowed for cost, demands never are.
Exactly one JSON object reaches the wire: output is captured so a dispatcher that printed a decision and then died cannot have fail_open's object appended after it, putting two objects on the wire.
No surrogate code point survives wire: the module's one guarantee.
The journal is observability, never policy: every entry point swallows everything, because a gate that denied because its logger could not write would be a worse defect than the missing log.
The digest is SHA-256 truncated to 16 hex = 64 bits, for both the chain link and derive_id; a collision merges two demands into one licence or forges a chain link at a 64-bit birthday bound.
Fail direction is split: carriage fails OPEN (a wiring fault emits {} and exits 0), a decision that could not be computed fails CLOSED, and an event with no closed wire falls back to carriage.

The /compact cut: a bare /compact gets the vendored preserve list, one that already carries instructions is left untouched, and an automatic compaction cannot be instructed so that path only reports it ran unsteered.
A deny's subject is read back out of the rendered prose, last match, so the ledger key and what the agent was told cannot disagree.
The opening-move waiver: the three always occasions fire on the same first act, so a call discharging any one of them is progress and is not itself refused by the other two.

The construction anchor is one spelling (POINTS.md#[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*), read by everything that needs it -- dispatch renders the pointer only when it matches and the test fence asserts the shape it names.

An event is either an enforceable clause target or a named-and-justified non-enforcing bookkeeping event; one in neither set is undecided, and the event-surface law goes red rather than defaulting to unenforceable in silence.

The probe bound is measured, not assumed: an 8-segment command asks the same read-only probe question 16 times (2N exactly); at the 5000ms per-probe cap that is 80s against a 20s hook timeout, so the hook is canceled and the deny row fails OPEN through the hang.

The terminal-clause discriminator: for an ordinary clause the fixtures test the fingerprint, but a terminal clause's fingerprint is always (every Stop is the occasion) so the fixtures must test the guard instead, or the clause is unloadable for the wrong reason.
One table, no second place: this is the one clause table the package loads.

STOP_ROUNDS = 3: refusals of ONE ending are bounded, not the ending itself -- one refusal states the debt, a second proves it was read and ignored, a third is the last before the host's own stop-hook cap fails open in silence; exhausted, the ending passes with a fault row and the rows stay OPEN for the next ending.

Compaction rewrites the chain: compact drops every row of a session that owes nothing and RE-CHAINS what stays, so every prev/hash downstream of a dropped row changes. A hash recorded before a compaction does not match the same row after one, and no chain value is a stable external identifier.

The chain is advisory and UNREAD: verify_chain re-derives the chain and names the first divergent hash, and no shipped path calls it -- its only caller is tests/test_ledger_growth.py. The chain is an invariant that is written, never checked, so no session detects its own corruption.

A predicate kind with no shipped user is removed, not carried: a branch no witness input can select is a branch the fixtures cannot grade, so it loads clean forever. kind: tool, kind: nonzero and the unless exclusion list each had zero uses in clauses.json and were removed with their evaluators.

CLAUSE-UNLESS-RETIRED: removing an evaluator without refusing its spelling is the SOFT direction -- an ignored unless list WIDENS the match its author declared, from "matches P but not Q" to "matches P", silently. Every retired spelling is therefore refused by name rather than dropped.

The occasion side is NARROWER than the guard side: every occasion is always, a host tool enum, or an effect (three), while a guard may also be composed. A composition on the occasion side would be a pre-act attempt to separate two acts, which Theorem 3 says can only be done by name.
Definition any_of / all_of : a list of segment-coverings, keyed by membership rather than by list shape.
Theorem any_of_name_agnostic: a disjunction of name-agnostic coverings is name-agnostic.
Theorem all_of_name_agnostic: a conjunction of name-agnostic coverings is name-agnostic.
Theorem host_enum_immune: a covering reading only the host's tool_name field is mention-immune, since a mention arrives as a Bash call and the host reports the quoting program.
Variable tool_name : Text -> Program; Hypothesis mention_tool_name : forall c, tool_name (mention c) = quoting_program.
Theorem always_is_name_agnostic: the covering that reads no segment at all is name-agnostic; renaming changes nothing it could see.

Theorem disj_with_textual_not_mention_immune: a disjunction with a non-vacuous textual disjunct is not mention-immune -- the disjunct alone is already defeated by Theorem 1 and the disjunction fires whenever a disjunct does.
Inductive ReadsFrom := ReadsHostEnum | ReadsWorld | ReadsDatum. A Definition only: nothing in this file separates the three by proof.
Definition occasion_fires + Theorem unmeasured_occasion_fires: an unmeasured occasion (None) is treated as FIRED, not passed.
Definition guard_paid/licensed + Theorem unmeasured_guard_never_licenses: no trace with an unmeasured guard is ever licensed; the two fail directions are opposite by construction.
